_doc: Real `sinatra-contrib-4.2.1/lib/sinatra/required_params.rb` vendored 1:1 under `vendor/sinatra/required_params.rb`. Second sinatra-contrib fixture (after multi_route_smoke). Exercises the helper-mixin path (`helpers RequiredParams` at module-level installs into Sinatra::Base via the upgraded register-extends), Hash#key? + recursion + Array key forms, and `halt 400` from a helper invoked inside a route. The `&.` safe-navigation in `p&.key?` lands cleanly thanks to the safe-nav AST desugar (commit a50fd84a). Nested-Hash key shapes need Rack's `user[name]=...` query parser which sinatra_lite doesn't ship — scenarios cover the two helper-recursion branches sinatra_lite's flat params can exercise.
name: required_params_smoke
